claims.gist: Five product capabilities will dominate in 2026
Supply chain malware detection is now a priority in application security assessments
Shai Hulud compromised thousands of organizations in recent attacks
Developer adoption of npm wrappers and firewalls is extremely low
Many AI vulnerability and CTEM startups consolidated in 2025
Major cloud providers' AI guardrails will outgrow security-specific runtime guardrail tools
Code-instrumented AI guardrails are best left to major AI providers
AI-based detections are a categorical improvement across SAST, DAST, DLP and phishing

thesis: Supply chain malware detection, AI remediation, AI guardrails and AI detections will dominate 2026 security product priorities.
